summary: Iter67 frontend-only verification of structural SEO fixes: (1) reviews removed from homepage, (2) RelatedEventsGraph + EditorialByline on event pages, (3) CategoryIntro on schedule pages. All 8 functional spec items effectively PASS. Mobile viewport 390x844.
action_items: MINOR/DOC: Review request mentions route '/f1-schedule', but the actual registered route in App.js is '/f1-2026-schedule' (and that is also what RelatedEventsGraph internal-graph links to). CategoryIntro renders correctly there. No code change needed — just a spec wording note.

Optional: HomePage.jsx still imports {ReviewsGrid, ReviewsStats} from ReviewsSystem although the section is wrapped/removed. Currently harmless (no eslint break) but can be deleted to keep imports clean.
critical_code_review_comments: RelatedEventsGraph dedupes by slug/event_id correctly and silently no-ops when nothing matches — good defensive UX.
CategoryIntro emits FAQPage JSON-LD only when faqs are provided — schema is conditional and clean.
EditorialByline defaults Last Reviewed to today's date dynamically; if SEO desires stable timestamps consider passing lastReviewedISO from a CMS field instead of letting it shift each render.

verification_results.1_reviews_removed_from_home: PASS — none of WHAT FANS SAY / Sarah Mitchell / Michael O'Brien / 2,940 Total Reviews / 5.0 Average Rating present in body innerText
verification_results.2_related_events_graph_on_chinese_gp: PASS — [data-testid=related-events-graph] present; 'Other F1 races' bucket renders 4 sibling F1 races; intent links include /how-to-buy-f1-tickets, /f1-2026-schedule, /f1-ticket-prices-guide
verification_results.3_editorial_byline_on_chinese_gp: PASS — [data-testid=editorial-byline] present with 'Reviewed by the EuroMatchTickets ticketing team', 'Munich', 'support@euromatchtickets.com', 'Last reviewed' all confirmed
verification_results.4_related_events_graph_on_taylor_swift_c: PASS — graph renders; concert intent links /concerts-in-london-2026, /concerts-in-paris-2026, /concerts-in-amsterdam-2026 ALL found
verification_results.5_category_intro_on_f1_schedule: PASS on real route /f1-2026-schedule — H2 'About the F1 2026 season', 4 <details> FAQs, 1 ld+json script with FAQPage schema
verification_results.6_category_intro_on_motogp_schedule: PASS — H2 'About the MotoGP 2026 season', 4 <details> FAQs, FAQPage JSON-LD present
verification_results.7_regression_iter65_iter66_pytest: NOT RE-RUN this iter (testing_type=frontend only, backend untouched). Both suites previously passing per iter66 report.
verification_results.8_backend_event_endpoints_for_graph: PASS — GET /api/events?event_type=f1&limit=4 returns 4 F1 events (Chinese GP, Miami, etc.); GET /api/events?city=Madrid&limit=4 returns Madrid Open and other Madrid events. Data sources for RelatedEventsGraph are healthy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter67 structural SEO additions verified live on production preview URL. RelatedEventsGraph + EditorialByline + CategoryIntro confirmed rendering with proper data-testids and content. Only nit: review request listed route '/f1-schedule' which 404s; the implemented route is '/f1-2026-schedule' (consistent with App.js routing and the intent links emitted by RelatedEventsGraph itself). Fake reviews fully purged from home (only the unused ReviewsGrid/ReviewsStats import remains harmlessly in HomePage.jsx).
